scope: Verify fixture provenance and reconstruct reference associations on the already inspected 10000-event subset. This is a data-adequacy step, not a new tracking method or decision-benefit experiment.
prior_results: The small merged fixture has already been found byte-identical to all records with its event IDs in the full merged fixture: 99478 rows, 10000 events, from 1116936 rows and 112700 events. These identity results are retrospective. The rebuild comparison below has not been evaluated before this protocol and executable are frozen.
fixed_procedure: Replay the unmodified upstream track-association routines with all six planes and the supplied geometry. Require exact field agreement with the saved TrackCandidates_result.h5 before interpreting the projected reconstruction. These are candidate associations, not fitted trajectories.

Construct a separate input containing only event IDs and fields of reference planes 0,1,2,4,5. Remove rows with no reference hit. Do not pass DUT3 columns, its geometry or all-detector hit flags to the reference finder. This removes detector influence at per-event association given the fixed published alignment; it does not independently calibrate that alignment.

Run the same established finder on these five planes. Compare complete five-reference cluster tuples, including event ID, with the corresponding six-plane associations. Report lost, gained and shared tuples; no physical false-association rate or improved efficiency follows from disagreement alone.

Check that replacing DUT3 fields or adding rows containing only DUT3 hits leaves the projected input byte-identical. Check a split at the median event boundary gives the same reference associations as the complete subset.

Only inspect detection/association outcomes in Merged_small. Use Merged_result to compare subset identity and count event IDs outside it. Keep those other 102700 event outcomes unanalyzed pending a useful decision, matched strong comparators, calibration model and separate frozen evaluation protocol.
limits: Published alignment used this development subset, including DUT3. Conditional input independence is not statistical independence or physical validation.

The full merged file identifies its six upstream clustered files. Raw-to-cluster conversion, trigger selection and detector settings still require adequate provenance before a physical efficiency claim.

Reference-only association and excluded-detector fits are established practice. BTA and Corryvreckan/GBL or Kalman tracking remain eligible comparators. A correction to an all-hit or detector-influenced reference alone is not a new-method advantage.
Multiple tracks per event, matching uncertainty, finite alignment precision and detector acceptance remain explicit calibration obligations. No iid row assumption is made.
All prior studies/manuscripts stay frozen. No Lean, hardware, outreach, deployment or publication is selected by this check.
